description:
* Lead and support Cashiers in handling daily transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal policies and regulations.
* Monitor daily cash inflows and outflows, ensuring proper cash flow management and financial control.
* Prepare and review cashiering and banking reports, payment documents, and funding-related documentation.
* Coordinate with banks on account management, fund transfers, banking services, and other banking-related matters.
* Liaise with Accounting, Finance, and relevant departments to ensure smooth cashiering and banking operations.
* Supervise and guide team members, review their work, and support improvements in operational processes and internal controls.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance & Banking, or a related field.
* Experience: At least of 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable (AP), Treasury. Prior experience in a Team Lead, Deputy Team Lead, or Supervisory role is preferred.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
* Good command of English.
* Excellent communication skills.
